header.baseline_vintage: current law as it will stand in January 2029, against the adopted baseline (CBO, February 2026) that dossiers/home/6-cost.md prices each provision over (ASM-INCREMENT); the subsidy starts from HUD's 2023 spending per voucher unit (EV-HOU-370); the pools from HUD's Worst Case Housing Needs 2025 (2023 data)
header.disclaimer: Project 2050 analysis of the evidence: not an official score or a benefit determination. It never stands in for a CBO or JCT estimate or for an agency's decision on an individual case.
header.scoring_convention: conventional, as a CBO score: no offsetting savings outside housing's accounts, no macroeconomic feedback, no interest; credit lines on a credit-reform basis as 6-cost.md prices them; the rent readings are a separate reading of the evidence, not booked and never added to any line
header.uncertainty: bounds, not probability intervals: low and high move every judgment input in the same direction (6-cost.md); lines built from decided amounts carry 6-cost.md's own ranges; the rent readings move their three inputs together; supply is a range from the evidence, not a forecast
header.units: $ billion, nominal, a cost positive (the tax credits' revenue loss positive), by federal fiscal year; households and homes as counts

by_income_band.income_band: no separate income test in HOU-4.03; the voucher rules' income limits apply (most awards go to extremely low-income households under 42 U.S.C. 1437n(b); not modeled)
by_income_band.note: people and households are different units, so the counts give scale, not a share

rents.spillover_note: rent paid by unassisted low-income renters in tight markets: 0 (EV-HOU-096) to the high reading, which applies Susin's 1974-93 ratio of 1.41 (EV-HOU-397) "if the ratio held"; no central reading, since the evidence is split (7-validation.md 5.1); never added to landlord capture or to the cost

supply_range.local_rent_effect: each 10% more housing nearby lowers rents about 1% (EV-HOU-133); a local effect, not a national elasticity
supply_range.net_homes_added_basis: 0 if building is fully offset (EV-HOU-115, tax credits) to the construction money's high count times EV-HOU-114's half a home; 7-validation.md 1.4 reads about 0.2-0.5 million
supply_range.statement: a range from the evidence, not a forecast

rents.warning_signal: 7-validation.md section 6: rent growth for units near the payment standard more than 2 points a year above other units for two years, in tight markets, triggers a review (8-change-our-minds.md)
